scope: Proposition 4.10 (Summable directional pinching) of the manuscript “Bi-Lipschitz Coordinates at Regular Points of Noncollapsed RCD Spaces” (preprints/Bi-Lipschitz-Coordinates-at-Regular-Points-of-Noncollapsed-RCD-Spaces-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 357 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5500abd2391d2387), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 30. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
